design: Original HG009 fixed 100 selected, 100 one-lane, 100 zero-lane identities. No changed selection, weights, outcome dates or frozen files.
entry: 2026-10-15 official NSE EQ open proxy, not fill
exit: 2026-11-12 official NSE EQ close from previously frozen 20-session Muhurat amendment
admission: Exact original symbol and ISIN and EQ series with valid OHLC every one of the 20 exact holding sessions. Missing identities remain in original100 denominators and receive null price outcome.
sources: 19 HG009 original daily packets, original full-market Nov8 H021 archive, SHA256 checks of all stock/index bytes. Original packets and controls immutable.
reported: Conditional-on-observed arm mean, median, positive-change frequency, full missing reasons, raw mean gaps and Nifty500 PRICE index; H1/H5 arithmetic comparison to existing sealed report.
not_reported: economic total return, after-cost return, significance, causal alpha, long-run ranking, investment BUY approval
limitations: Corporate actions and dividends not resolved. Liquidity-band controls not sector/size/beta matched. One common entry event, overlapping H1/H5/H20, no independent replications.
prior_outcome_exposure: Prior H1/H5 and H021 H20 were visible. HG009 H20 numbers not read before selecting audit method. This is retrospective calculation of a frozen endpoint, not a new preregistration.
